baslik: How does a wind turbine make electricity? 🌬️ #shorts

Energy Sources, episode 2: wind. How wind forms, how giant blades are built, the nacelle, transport, installation, power generation and storm mode. Model: NREL 5 MW reference turbine (126 m rotor, 90 m hub, 97:1 gearbox).

Narration uses an AI voice clone; visuals are code-generated 3D animation; music is an original AI-generated track.
